original_criteria.criterion: Identify metallic zinc in both phases near its declared melting transition.
Any oxide formation must have its own oxygen source and reaction accounting; melting alone cannot create ZnO.

bounded_energy_arithmetic.method: initial-phase sensible integral plus actual phase-fraction latent change; open ethanol export counted
bounded_energy_arithmetic.note: A large mismatch is retained as evidence, never a fitted property or repaired forecast.

qualification: Independent saved-output arithmetic within declared property/model domains. Composite Simpson integration uses pinned NASA9/Shomate Cp curves and source endpoint clamping, with constant legacy Cp only where no curve is present. All original raw thermal and solver events retained. No universal energy closure, calorimetric calibration or current-source reproduction is claimed; uncomputed mixture/reaction/export domains remain pending.
